purpose: A single tall content container with no repeating section structure — used for the changelog feed and the SVB update FAQ.
notes: changelog (27,872px) and svb-update (2,556px) are both a single Container>long-form-content node — by far the widest height range of any template, entirely a function of accumulated content length rather than layout.

Round 3: added the trailing site-footer node. Both /changelog/ and /svb-update/'s live builds render a real Footer__ component (confirmed in the served index.html); this template previously ended on long-form-content with no documented reason (unlike the deliberate, documented omission for protected-deposits-page/simple-page in README's Known Gaps section).
